When you keep your prices artificially low, your brain tells you: "If they say no, it's just because it wasn't worth much anyway."
It feels safe. It shields your ego. But it keeps you trapped in an endless loop of over-delivering and exhaustion.
Real confidence isn't knowing everyone will buy. It's being 100% OK even if they don't.
📌 Save this post for your next pricing call.
